title: The external layer: what an MLE-bench run needs, checked and named, and a run refused until it is all here and capped
request: The owner asked for external benchmarks to compare DCLab with others.
spec: A check of the grader, the Kaggle key, the data, the disk and the chosen competitions; a plan of the run; a run refused until ready and given a cap; never a key's value printed.

decisions.decision: Build the check and the refusals now, the grading when the grader is here
decisions.why: a runner that pretends to run without the grader and the data would be a fake result

change: dclab_rnd/bench/external/ (new, tasks.json empty until the owner chooses), bench/__main__.py (external), docs/guides/BENCHMARK.md, tests/test_bench_external.py.

findings.defect: Nothing a real external run needs is on this machine
findings.cause: no grader, no Kaggle key, no data, too little free disk, no competitions chosen
findings.fix: not a code fix: the check names each

measurements.name: the first check
limits: the grading step is not written until the grader is installed

outcome: The owner sees exactly what an external run needs before anything is spent.
lessons: say what is missing rather than ship a runner that cannot run
risks: MLE-bench's interface may change before it is installed here
